metadata.sql:
SELECT 
    d1.driver_code,
    d1.driver_name,
    d1.constructor,
    d1.position,
    d1.year,
    d1.grand_prix
FROM v_race_results d1
WHERE d1.year = 2021 
  AND ((lower(d1.grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(d1.grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(d1.grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(d1.circuit_country) = 'brazil') OR lower(d1.grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR (lower(d1.grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' OR lower(d1.grand_prix) LIKE '%são paulo%' OR lower(d1.grand_prix) LIKE '%sao paulo%' OR lower(d1.circuit_country) = 'brazil'))
  AND d1.position = 1
metadata.chart_title: Who won the 2021 Brazilian Grand Prix and what was the winning margin over P2?
